method.control: Implementation is limited to one dependency-free non-exhaustive in-memory MemoryRelationType enum, focused tests, and morize-core re-exports. No MemoryRelation struct, relation endpoints, edge class, inference/evidence thresholds, graph traversal or mutation, authorization, serialization, persistence, or third-party dependency is authorized.
method.review_separation: An independent semantic reviewer must review the exact implementation head, exact initial-relation fidelity, non-exhaustive extensibility, absence of graph/inference/authority semantics, scope containment, and required evidence separately from the implementing agent before acceptance.
method.rollback: Revert the memory-relation-type implementation commits; no persisted format, graph state, inference policy, authorization rule, or user data depends on this Grain.

outcome: morize-core exposes one dependency-free non-exhaustive MemoryRelationType enum covering the 11 initial relation types already fixed by docs/DATA_MODEL.md, without defining relation endpoints, edge inference class, evidence thresholds, graph traversal, serialization, persistence, or policy behavior.
rationale: P1 requires MemoryRelation, and docs/DATA_MODEL.md already fixes the initial relation vocabulary. This Grain adds only the typed in-memory relation-type vocabulary so later edge-class, relation-structure, evidence, policy, and graph contracts can build on one definition without inventing inference or graph semantics.
title: Add baseline memory relation type vocabulary
